build_Pippo_multiview_diffusion_model: build a Pippo multiview diffusion transformer model with configurable compressor, generator, schedule, and conditioning encoders
run_Pippo_forward: run the Pippo forward pass with image, keypoints, reference image, camera poses, and plucker coordinates for training
create_RefEncoder: create a RefEncoder module to encode reference images with patchify and 2D sinusoidal positional embeddings
test_Pippo_encode_decode: test the Pippo encode_image and decode_image methods to verify VAE compression and reconstruction
review_Pippo_get_conds: review the Pippo get_conds method to understand how reference image, camera pose, plucker, and keypoints conditioning are assembled
